messages:
mike_infra: Kicking off a preflight for a NEW EKS cluster in ap-south-3. Purpose: GPU inference stage (model validation + perf testing). Meeting-free run, will do handoff notes here. Starting checks at 13:00 UTC.

sara_network: :eyes: ok. What VPC layout are we using — single AZ private, or multi-AZ with private subnets + NAT? Need to pre-check NAT gateway quotas (cost + IPs).

mike_infra: Multi-AZ private subnets (3 AZs). NAT gateways in each AZ to avoid cross-AZ egress. VPC CIDR 10.40.0.0/16, pod CIDR 100.80.0.0/16. Will enable AWS::EKS privateEndpoint + publicEndpoint=false for control plane.

jordan_sre: ENI/IP quota is the usual gotcha with GPU instances. Please run account-limit check: `aws ec2 describe-instance-type-offerings` and `aws ec2 describe-instance-types --instance-types g5.2xlarge` then `aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A` (ENIs/sec). Also confirm available Elastic IPs for NATs.

mike_infra: Done: preliminary ENI headroom looks OK for target 8 nodes. Filing quota raise now for burst to 20 nodes in case autoscale spikes.

lucy_coreservices: For node AMI we should use Amazon EKS-optimized + GPU driver bundle. Plan: `eksctl` to create managed nodegroup with label `gpu=true` and bootstrap with userdata to install NVIDIA drivers. We'll also apply `nvidia-device-plugin-daemonset` after cluster ready.

kevin_prodeng: Cost callout: g5.xxx add ~3-4x cost vs g4dn. If we only need FP16 perf for some tests, we can spin a smaller test pool (g4dn.xlarge) first and save $$$. Recommend two nodegroups: `gpu-small` (g4dn.xlarge, 2 nodes) + `gpu-prod` (g5.2xlarge, 2 nodes) for validation.

mike_infra: Good idea — I'll add both. Autoscaler config: cluster-autoscaler on nodegroups with tagged ASG names `eksctl-redwood-*gpu*`. Will use scale-down delay 10m to avoid flapping.

sara_network: Networking checklist:
- Security groups: API SG restricted to corp VPN + management CIDRs.
- Worker SG: allow outbound 0.0.0.0/0, inbound only from NLBs for inference services and from ops bastion on SSH (jumpbox).
- Route tables: ensure private subnets point to NATs.
- CNI: aws-vpc-cni disabled trunking? For GPU workloads with high pod-per-node, enable `WARM_ENI_TARGET` config to reduce ENI churn.

jordan_sre: Also: confirm `maxPods` settings on kubelet for instance types. GPUs often have smaller `maxPods` which interacts with ENI limits. Add calculation doc: `maxPods = floor((ipv4AddressesPerENI * numberOfENIs) - reserved)`.

mike_infra: Added a quick script to calculate maxPods and ENI needs in the repo. I'll paste here after creation.

lucy_coreservices: Add-ons: required list we will apply immediately after control plane up:
- CoreDNS (scale to 3)
- kube-proxy (ensure iptables mode)
- metrics-server (Helm)
- cluster-autoscaler (Helm)
- nvidia-device-plugin (k8s daemonset)
- nvidia-driver-installer (daemonset for AMI-less nodes)
- aws-ebs-csi-driver (for model checkpoints)
- Calico for network policy (or AWS VPC CNI + network-policy plugin).

kevin_prodeng: Quick QA: we need rollout gating so production traffic doesn't hit the new cluster. Add Route53 entries under `staging.*` only, and a manual cutover doc. Also tag nodes with `env=staging` and `team=infra`.

mike_infra: Will do. Handoff items to include in runbook: kubeconfig export, eksctl create command used, IAM OIDC setup for IRSA, driver DS apply link, autoscaler args, and rollback notes.

mike_infra: Example `eksctl` invocation we plan to run: 
```
eksctl create cluster --name redwood-ap3 --region ap-south-3 \
  --managed --with-oidc \
  --nodegroup-name gpu-small --node-type g4dn.xlarge --nodes 2 --nodes-min 1 --nodes-max 4 \
  --node-ami auto \
  --node-labels "gpu=true,env=staging"
```

jordan_sre: After cluster creation run: `kubectl get nodes -o wide`, `kubectl describe node <node>` check allocatable GPUs, `kubectl logs -n kube-system daemonset/nvidia-driver-installer` and `kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide` for coredns/metrics.

sara_network: ACL note: NACLs must allow ephemeral ports (1024-65535) between nodes and control-plane. If using strict NACLs, add explicit rules. Also check SG outbound for ECR/EFS endpoints and STS.

mike_infra: Quick status updates will follow here. Plan to create cluster at 13:05 UTC, run validation script for 30m, then handoff doc. Will ping when done. :rocket:

deploy-bot: cluster redwood-ap3 creation started (eksctl job id=cli-7421).

kevin_prodeng: Thanks — once validation passes I'll open a PR to enable routing to staging ALB.

mike_infra: Done for now. I'll post final diff + links to runbook artifacts and the autoscaler Helm values in ~45 mins.
__notes: Slack thread style. All messages in single continuous string. No title field as per agents.md.
